description: Classify a float from its bit pattern as NaN, infinite, zero, subnormal or normal (__fpclassifyf)
notes: musl 1.2.5, __fpclassifyf (src/math/__fpclassifyf.c). The float argument is replaced by its IEEE-754 bit pattern, which the original reads through a union, so the function is integer-only; musl's values FP_NAN = 0, FP_INFINITE = 1, FP_ZERO = 2, FP_SUBNORMAL = 3 and FP_NORMAL = 4 are inlined. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: a switch on the exponent byte, two masked compares and a phi: 13 IR instructions. Whether a shorter or branchless form is better is unknown.
